description: Defines the QuicClientPromisedInfo class which manages the client-side state of server push streams in QUIC HTTP/2 implementation, including handling promise headers, responses, and rendezvous with client requests.

classes.name: QuicClientPromisedInfo
classes.description: Manages the client-side state of a server push stream, including promise validation, response handling, and rendezvous with client requests.

classes.name: QuicClientPromisedInfo::CleanupAlarm
classes.description: A nested class that handles cleanup alarms for the promised info object.

methods.name: QuicClientPromisedInfo
methods.description: Constructor initializing the promised info with session, stream ID, and URL.

methods.name: OnPromiseHeaders
methods.description: Validates promise headers; returns true if headers are valid.

methods.name: OnResponseHeaders
methods.description: Stores response headers and proceeds with validation.

methods.name: HandleClientRequest
methods.description: Handles a client request matching the promise, performing rendezvous.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the promise with a given error code.

methods.name: request_headers
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the request headers.

methods.name: response_headers
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the response headers.

methods.name: url
methods.description: Returns the URL associated with the promise.

methods.name: is_validating
methods.description: Returns true if a client request is pending validation.
